list.heading: Templates
list.intro: A template marks where each answer goes on a blank form. Create one per form layout, then use it to extract values from filled copies.
list.empty: No templates yet. Scan a blank form to create your first one.
list.caption: Saved templates

new.heading: New template
new.uploadIntro: Upload an empty copy of the form. Labels and answer areas are detected automatically, and you can adjust them afterwards.

new.detectedFields_other: Detected {{count}} fields. Check them below, then name and save the template.
